AUTOMATED JOB DISCOVERY

Find matching roles.

Search configured public employer boards or run the broad live index below. Board refresh follows the local search interval; broad-index searches are user-triggered. LinkedIn is not connected.

SUPPORTED PUBLIC CAREER BOARDS

Public boards and the broad index

Search configured employer boards and public job APIs. Board refresh follows the local search interval; the broad index runs when you start a search. Source publication delays still apply.

Search the broader job index

live Freehire results

Search public technology postings by role title, then rank them against your verified Neural Ant profile. Your resume and work-authorization details stay in Neural Ant; only this query and the selected filters are sent to the job index.

Role titles default from My profile. H-1B and visa wording is inspected in each posting; C2C stays a separate employment signal.

Public job source

one-time setup

Choose an employer board or public job API. Neural Ant reads public listings only.

Source status appears after Search now. Empty boards are shown separately from source errors.

Employer boards need no API credentials. Adzuna and USAJOBS require API credentials in local .env.local.

Sponsorship history

optional evidence CSV

Import employer-level historical filings to improve the sponsorship signal. This does not prove a role will sponsor, and does not replace checking the posting or asking the employer.

Required CSV headers: company_name,evidence_url,evidence_year,filing_count. Supports a normalized export from official DOL disclosure data.

Rank and filter results

fit and sponsorship evidence

An explicit posting statement is the strongest listing signal, but it still needs employer confirmation for a new H‑1B petition and this specific role. Historical filings and C2C are separate signals.

ROLE FIT ANALYSIS

Is this role right for you?

Compare job evidence, saved skills, location, salary, work mode, and unknowns with your profile.

Fit scores are ranking hints based on your profile, not a prediction of hiring outcomes.

APPLICATION PIPELINE

Keep every opportunity moving.

Track stages, notes, outcomes, and follow-up dates. Mark a role Done after you submit it. Done roles stay out of fresh search; past applications from employer sites are not imported automatically.

AI COPILOT

Prepare your next application.

Create reviewable drafts grounded in the profile details you provide.

External AI is optional and requires confirmation for each application pack. The review pass flags factual, requirement-coverage, and ATS wording issues; it cannot verify meaning or guarantee ATS results. Review every claim yourself.

YOUR VERIFIED BASELINE

My profile

Profile and resume stay in your private app database. Uploading a resume fills supported profile and application-history fields from its text; verify them before searching.

Resume

No resume uploaded

Your resume upload fills supported facts automatically. Set preferences only when they are missing or need correction.

WORKFLOW TOOLS

More of your job search, in one place.

Review public profile evidence, choose a resume template, exchange pipeline data, and manage local workspace data.

Expand profile from public sources

suggestions need approval

Paste relevant text copied from your public GitHub profile, portfolio, Kaggle, Scholar page, or course syllabus. The text is sent to your Neural Ant server, which scans for known technical skills and stores the cited excerpt with each suggestion. It does not fetch URLs or treat source text as instructions.

Custom resume templates

Word .docx

Register a Word template to preserve its page setup, headers, footers, and Normal font and size when Neural Ant generates a tailored resume. New documents use the template body style; your original file stays private in the local database.

Application status and data exchange

local, review-first tools

Review a Gmail message

Neural Ant has no connected Gmail account here. Paste one message you exported or copied; its text is sent to your Neural Ant server for review. The classifier does not use an external AI provider or save the email body.

Export the pipeline

Download a Notion-ready CSV for manual import, or an offline HTML report. These exports contain job and application tracking fields only; they exclude your resume and profile contact details.

CSV is a one-time export, not a live Notion connection. The JSON backup includes your profile and is sensitive; keep it private.

Reset local workspace data

irreversible deletion

Choose one scope. Neural Ant asks for a typed confirmation before deleting anything.

Reset profile keeps the uploaded resume and job pipeline. Reset documents keeps profile and job pipeline. Reset all clears the full local workspace.
